task.question: What title did the Lynx clinch?
task.evidence: Fowles answered the call. She racked up 17 points and broke her own WNBA rebounds record with 20. Her effort was matched by that of Maya Moore, with 18 points and 10 rebounds; Lindsay Whalen, who had 17 points and eight assists; and Seimone Augustus, who added another 14 points, six assists and six rebounds. The Lynx showed out , clinching the franchise’s fourth title, with Fowles named finals MVP.
task.page: ‘It’s payback time’: the WNBA-leading Lynx are on the hunt for title redemption

answer: The Lynx clinched the WNBA Championship title. FINAL: WNBA Championship
